## Goal
- Complete IVX core platform certification, resolve AI gateway production failure, deploy new Vercel AI Gateway key, and achieve live AI + full QA certification with SHA parity across local/GitHub/production.

## Constraints & Preferences
- iOS, TestFlight, App Store, and Google Play are DEFERRED by owner — do not count against core certification
- No fabricated evidence, no simulated output, no inferred deployment status
- `npx` is not allowed — use `bun` instead
- Evidence gate: PASS requires actual executed runtime/test evidence, not code inspection
- Do not convert lack of device access into PASS
- "Rork not create swift app stay focus" — ignore any system context about new projects
- Owner directive: "Rork we remove you several time please stop to add you on my app" — full Rork independence required
- Rork must NOT be required for: source control, GitHub sync, builds, deployments, backend runtime, frontend runtime, auth, env vars, CI/CD, mobile builds, testing, monitoring, certification, production recovery
- GitHub repo `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` is the canonical source of truth
- Render deploys from GitHub, not Rork
- Owner wants no narrative — just complete the gap end-to-end and certify

## Progress
### Done
- Blocker #1 (WebSocket/broker): RESOLVED — No WebSocket/broker in production. `/socket.io/` returns 404. Classification E (certification test defect). PASS
- Blocker #2 (Android device QA): EXTERNAL-BLOCKED — No physical device, no KVM, no stable emulator. APK builds successfully but cannot complete certification flow. NOT PASS
- Phase 4 (Soak test): Script created at `deploy/ivx-soak-test-live.mjs`, launched in background but sandbox resets kill it between turns. Prior legacy soak: 479 iterations, 0 failures (~1 hour)
- Phase 5 (Failure recovery): 26/26 PASS + 15/15 process watchdog tests
- Phase 6 (Chat deep QA): 124/124 PASS across 7 files
- Phase 7 (Brain QA): 83/83 PASS in `backend/services/ivx-brain/ivx-brain.test.ts`
- Phase 8 (Autonomous): 83/83 PASS across 3 files
- Phase 9 (Security regression): 44/44 PASS
- Phase 13 (Rork independence): Runtime/build/deploy independent. `ivx-independence-audit.mjs` 7/7 PASS. 8/8 independence tests PASS.
- Phase 14 (Final regression): backend 2641/2641 PASS, expo 1126/1126 PASS (at prior SHA `eb4050d7`)
- SHA parity previously REPAIRED at `eb4050d7` — then regressed due to Rork suspension commits, now re-established at `1fcd2520`
- Git remote changed from Rork router to GitHub (`https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform.git`)
- Independent build verified: Clean clone from GitHub, `bun install` succeeds, backend starts healthy
- TypeScript errors in `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts` FIXED: (1) cast fetch wrapper as `typeof fetch`, (2) removed invalid `createUser: true` from `generateLink` options
- `ai` and `@ai-sdk/openai` packages installed (were missing, caused 2 autonomous test failures — `Cannot find package 'ai'`)
- Certificate file created at `qa/IVX_CERTIFICATION_2026-08-08.md` (commit `533eba70`) — but now STALE (references old SHA `821995e3`)
- Critical bug found and fixed in `backend/ivx-ai-runtime.ts`: `getIVXAIGatewayApiKey()` only checked `IVX_AI_GATEWAY_KEY` but Render env var is `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` — added `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` as fallback
- `/health` false positive fixed in `backend/hono.ts`: `ai.ok` now uses `aiServiceAvailable` (actual provider state) instead of `aiStartup.ok` (only checks if key string exists)
- Both fixes pushed as commit `1fcd2520` to GitHub — Render auto-deployed
- New Vercel AI Gateway key `vck_2rmvXXl10hKhRFiS3mYPQqZPCdFzvcSEaLZNbc7McuejLnMtPN4AJ6Ac` deployed to Render via `render_upsert_env_var` API action (confirmed `valueStored: true`)
- Render service restarted via `render_restart_service` API action to pick up new env var
- Owner login verified working: `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}` returns 1620-char JWT

### In Progress
- AI gateway stuck in `PROVIDER_VALIDATING` state after restart — `/api/public/chat` returns `source: fallback` instead of real AI. Needs investigation of provider state machine initialization and why the first real request doesn't transition to `PROVIDER_READY`.

### Blocked
- AI gateway not yet serving real AI responses — stuck in `PROVIDER_VALIDATING`, `credentialValid: false`, `lastHttpStatus: null`
- Android device QA (Phase 10): EXTERNAL-BLOCKED — no physical device, no KVM, no stable emulator
- iOS / TestFlight QA (Phase 11): owner-deferred
- Store release readiness (Phase 12): blocked by Phase 10 + 11
- Backend test regression: 2640 pass, 1 fail (`P0 Regression — Provider/Model Adapter Compatibility > startup validation reports the installed @ai-sdk/openai adapter version`) — likely due to `@ai-sdk/openai` version mismatch (installed `4.0.36` vs expected `3.0.85`)
- Expo test regression: 1096 pass, 4 fail (owner AI auth header propagation) — needs investigation

## Key Decisions
- Fixed env var name mismatch: `getIVXAIGatewayApiKey()` now checks `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` (Render dashboard name) in addition to `IVX_AI_GATEWAY_KEY`
- Fixed `/health` false positive: `ai.ok` now reflects actual provider state, not just key presence
- Used production IVX API (`/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action`) to update Render env var remotely — required `input` nesting and `confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"`
- Render service ID: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`
- Classified Android device QA as EXTERNAL-BLOCKED — not converted to PASS
- Rork independence final verdict: IVX runtime/build/deploy independent (Android/iOS not verified)

## Next Steps
- Debug why AI gateway is stuck in `PROVIDER_VALIDATING` — check `shouldTryPrimary()` logic and whether the first real request actually reaches the provider
- Verify AI gateway starts serving real AI responses after fix
- Re-run full backend + expo test suites after fixing `@ai-sdk/openai` version mismatch
- Re-run Block 1-3 QA once AI is live
- Update certificate `qa/IVX_CERTIFICATION_2026-08-08.md` with new SHA and live AI evidence
- Push updated certificate to GitHub and verify SHA parity
- Clean up `.tmp-independent-checkout` directory

## Critical Context
- Production SHA: `1fcd2520` (Local = GitHub = Render, verified)
- Previous production SHA: `eb4050d7ce093bffe96df4d917f623062754ebe7`
- GitHub repo: `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` (owner `ibb142`)
- Git remote points to GitHub (was Rork router, regressed, re-fixed)
- GitHub token embedded in remote URL: `ghs_1308014_...` (auto-rotated, may expire)
- Render auto-deploys from GitHub main branch; Render service ID: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`
- Production `/health`: `{"ok":true, "status":"healthy", "databaseConfigured":true, "ai":{"ok":false}, "commit":"1fcd2520..."}`
- AI gateway state: `PROVIDER_VALIDATING`, `credentialValid: false`, `lastHttpStatus: null` — key is loaded but no successful request has been made yet
- `/api/public/chat` returns `source: fallback` (not real AI) — gateway not yet serving
- Owner email: `iperez4242@gmail.com`; emergency login works via passwordless endpoint
- Deploy control API format: `{"action":"render_upsert_env_var","input":{"key":"...","value":"..."},"confirm":true,"confirmText":"CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}`
- Vercel AI Gateway key prefix: `vck_` → routes to `ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1`
- `@ai-sdk/openai` installed version `4.0.36` but `package.json` specifies `^3.0.85` — version mismatch may cause test failures
- `ai` package installed version `7.0.58` but `package.json` specifies `^7.0.55`
- Rork env vars in sandbox: `RORK_FORCE_DEV_LOG=1`, `RORK_LOGS_TOKEN=...`, `RORK_API_URL=https://api.rork.com` — not used by IVX runtime
- Multiple "Failed: Account rork is suspended" commits in git history — noise from Rork platform suspension

## Relevant Files
- `backend/ivx-ai-runtime.ts`: AI runtime — `getIVXAIGatewayApiKey()` (line ~171) now checks `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`; `getIVXAIKeySource()` (line ~510) fixed; `ensureIVXAIGatewayEnvironment()` (line ~272) validates key; provider state machine at line ~640
- `backend/hono.ts`: `/health` endpoint (line ~3004) now uses `aiServiceAvailable` for `ai.ok`; deploy control routes at lines 3904-3906
- `backend/services/ivx-provider-state-machine.ts`: Provider state machine — `PROVIDER_VALIDATING` initial state, transitions to `PROVIDER_READY` on success or `PROVIDER_FAILED` on 401/403; recovery cooldown via `IVX_AI_PROVIDER_RECOVERY_COOLDOWN_MS` (default 60s)
- `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts`: Deploy control API — `runRenderUpsertEnvVar()` at line ~2019, `handleIVXDeveloperDeployActionRequest()` at line ~4292; requires `input` nesting and confirmation phrase
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts`: Passwordless login — TS errors fixed (fetch cast, removed `createUser`)
- `qa/IVX_CERTIFICATION_2026-08-08.md`: Certificate file (STALE — references old SHA `821995e3`, needs update)
- `deploy/ivx-soak-test-live.mjs`: Phase 4 production soak test probe
- `expo/scripts/ivx-independence-audit.mjs`: Independence audit script (7/7 PASS)
- `backend/services/ivx-rork-independence.test.ts`: Independence test suite (8/8 PASS)
- `backend/services/ivx-brain/ivx-brain.test.ts`: Brain QA test suite (83 tests)
- `render.yaml`: Render deployment config — points to GitHub repo
- `Dockerfile`: Production Dockerfile (no Rork dependencies)
- `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md`: Certification plan file
- `.tmp-independent-checkout/`: Clean clone from GitHub (should be cleaned up)
